text: Hi everyone, can anyone clarify the paperwork difference between requesting permanent residency vs. citizenship? ​I’m only applying for PR. Our clerk said to bring our usual renewal docs, a statement saying I know I qualify for citizenship but want PR instead, and form A6. But the A6 form asks for a bunch of extra documents and lawyer signatures that our clerk hasn't mentioned at all. Do we actually need to complete all those extra parts for permanent residency? I'm digging for info this entire morning and can't seem to find clear answers 😓 ​Thanks in advance!
